items.title: Indian minister resigns after student protests
Rebecka Kärde: What is Hello Kitty if not deformed?
items.summary: It is not for nothing that "kawaii" is one of the most famous words in Japanese. There, both the police and the big banks have small, cute animal mascots. Rebecka Kärde is in East Asia and lets her defenses fall before the ambiguous culture of cuteness.
items.title_original: Rebecka Kärde: Vad är Hello Kitty om inte vanskapt?
items.summary_original: Det är inte för inte som ”kawaii” är ett av japanskans kändaste ord. Där har såväl polisen som storbankerna små, söta djurmaskotar. Rebecka Kärde är i Östasien och låter försvaren falla inför den tvetydiga gullighetskulturen.

items.title: Sweden to contribute additional SEK 1.4 billion to World Bank operations in Ukraine
items.summary: The Government has today decided to provide SEK 1.4 billion in support to a new World Bank crisis facility that benefits Ukraine. This support enables new loans totalling approximately SEK 4.2 billion for the country’s reconstruction and recovery. The World Bank is a key actor for Ukraine’s reform efforts and economic resilience during Russia’s ongoing aggression. Sweden’s actions have been vital for the establishment of the new crisis facility.
